Separado do lobo floculonodular pela fis: Separated from the flocculonodular lobe by the posterolateral fissure and from the anterior lobe by the primary fissure.
Lóbulo cerebelar localizado superiorment: Cerebellar lobule located superior to the foramen magnum. In situations of intracranial hypertension, the tonsils can herniate through this foramen and compress the posterior region of the medulla oblongata, compromising the vasomotor and respiratory centers, which can be fatal.
Separado do lobo posterior pela fissura: Separated from the posterior lobe by the posterolateral fissure, corresponds to the vestibulocerebellum.
É o núcleo cerebelar mais lateral. Media: It is the most lateral cerebellar nucleus. Medial to it are located, in sequence, the interpositus (emboliform and globose) and fastigial nuclei.
É a substância branca que, no cerebelo,: It is the white matter which, in the cerebellum, is centrally located. It houses the four pairs of central nuclei of the cerebellum.
É a substância cinzenta do cerebelo. Ass: It is the gray matter of the cerebellum. Like the cerebrum, the cerebellum is part of the suprasegmental nervous system, therefore, it has gray matter (cortex) external to the white matter (medulla).
Dilatação oval que recebe os filamentos: Oval dilation that receives the filaments of the olfactory nerve (cranial nerve I), which pass through the cribriform plate of the ethmoid bone to enter the cranial cavity. The olfactory bulb continues posteriorly with the olfactory tract, both of which are lodged in the olfactory sulcus.
Local onde as fibras que carregam as inf: Location where the fibers carrying sensory information from the nasal retinas (consequently, from the temporal visual fields) cross to the opposite side.
Projeções arredondadas de substância cin: Rounded projections of gray matter (mammillary nuclei) located on the floor of the III ventricle, in the inferior region of the hypothalamus. The mammillary nuclei are one of the subcortical components of the limbic system.
Grosso feixe de fibras nervosas que se o: Thick bundle of nerve fibers that originate in the retina, emerge near the posterior pole of each eyeball, and enter the skull through the optic canal.
São duas cavidades repletas de líquor, l: Two cavities filled with CSF, located in the telencephalon, one in each hemisphere, which communicate with the III ventricle through the interventricular foramina.
É uma cavidade ímpar e mediana, repleta: It is an unpaired, median cavity, filled with CSF, located at the diencephalic level. It communicates with the IV ventricle through the cerebral aqueduct and with the lateral ventricles through the interventricular foramina.
Duas massas ovóides de substância cinzen: Two ovoid masses of gray matter that form the lateral walls of the III ventricle. All sensory information passes through the thalamus before reaching the cortex, except for olfaction.
Glândula situada no epitálamo, na região: Gland located in the epithalamus, in the posterior region of the diencephalon. It is very important in regulating the circadian rhythm and produces the hormone melatonin.
São em número de dois. Ligam cada ventrí: There are two of them. They connect each lateral ventricle to the III ventricle.
Feixe que une os dois tálamos. Atravessa: Bundle that unites the two thalami. It crosses the cavity of the III ventricle like a 'bridge'.
Localizada na transição entre o mesencéf: Located at the transition between the midbrain and the diencephalon. In it, the fibers from the Edinger-Westphal nuclei cross to the opposite side, enabling the consensual pupillary reflex.
Dilatação da medula em nível cervical, o: Enlargement of the spinal cord at the cervical level, where the nerve roots that form the brachial plexus connect.
Dilatação da medula em nível lombar, ond: Enlargement of the spinal cord at the lumbar level, where the nerve roots that form the lumbosacral plexus connect.
Prega longitudinal de pia-máter situada: Longitudinal fold of pia mater located on each side of the spinal cord, along its entire length. The medial margin of the ligament is continuous with the pia mater of the spinal cord; the lateral margin inserts into the arachnoid and dura mater at points alternating with the emergences of the spinal nerves. These ligaments are important landmarks in surgery and, together with the coccygeal ligament, provide support for the spinal cord.
É o conjunto formado pelo filamento term: It is the set formed by the filum terminale and the nerve roots of the last spinal nerves.
Filamento de pia-máter que continua caud: Filament of pia mater that continues caudally after the end of the spinal cord. Upon crossing the dural sac, it receives several extensions from the dura mater, and the assembly is then called the filum of the spinal dura mater. When it inserts into the periosteum of the dorsal surface of the coccyx, it constitutes the coccygeal ligament.
Porção final da medula espinal, cujo lim: Final portion of the spinal cord, whose caudal limit is generally at the level of the second lumbar vertebra (L2). Below the conus medullaris is the cauda equina.
Filamentos nervosos que emergem da medul: Nerve filaments that emerge from the spinal cord through the anterior and posterior lateral sulci, and unite to form the anterior and posterior roots of the spinal nerve, respectively.
Formado pela união da raiz sensitiva (do: Formed by the union of the sensory (dorsal) root and the motor (ventral) root.
Raiz Dorsal do Nervo Espinal: Dorsal Root of the Spinal Nerve
It is the sensory root of the spinal nerve.
Gânglio situado na raiz dorsal do nervo: Ganglion located on the dorsal root of the spinal nerve, where the bodies of pseudounipolar sensory neurons (first sensory neuron) are present.
Recebe informações sensoriais, como dor,: Receives sensory information, such as pain, temperature, and touch, from the dorsal roots of the spinal nerves. It acts as a transmission point for this information to the brain.
Conjunto de fibras nervosas que emergem: Set of nerve fibers that emerge from the spinal cord and form the roots of the spinal nerves.
Contém os neurônios motores inferiores,: Contains the lower motor neurons, whose axons form the ventral roots of the spinal nerves. It is part of the gray matter of the spinal cord and receives information from descending encephalic pathways.
É a mais externa e mais espessa das três: It is the outermost and thickest of the three meninges.
Ramo da artéria maxilar que, por sua vez: Branch of the maxillary artery which, in turn, is a branch of the external carotid artery. It nourishes the dura mater through its numerous branches and causes an epidural or extradural hematoma in case of traumatic rupture.
Canal venoso revestido por endotélio, si: Venous channel lined by endothelium, located between the two layers of the dura mater. It is situated along the attachment margin of the falx cerebri and drains encephalic venous blood to the confluence of sinuses.
Prega formada pelo desprendimento do fol: Fold formed by the detachment of the inner layer of the dura mater. It is located in the longitudinal fissure of the brain and marks the division between the left and right cerebral hemispheres.
Seio da dura-máter, com sentido antero-p: Sinus of the dura mater, running anteroposteriorly, it travels along the free margin of the falx cerebri, emptying into the straight sinus.
Seio venoso pequeno e retilíneo, drena o: Small and straight venous sinus, it drains blood from the inferior sagittal sinus to the confluence of sinuses.
Prega transversal formada pelo desprendi: Transverse fold formed by the detachment of the inner layer of the dura mater. It divides the cranial cavity into supratentorial and infratentorial compartments. It separates the occipital lobe of the brain from the cerebellum.
É a meninge mais interna e delicada, int: It is the innermost and most delicate meninx, intimately related to the nervous tissue. After the end of the spinal cord, at the conus medullaris, the pia mater continues as the filum terminale.
A dura-máter é a meninge mais externa e: The dura mater is the outermost and thickest meninx. It envelops the spinal cord along its entire length and ends forming the dural sac. The arachnoid is intimately related to the dura mater and emits arachnoid trabeculae, which cross the subarachnoid space towards the pia mater.
Localiza-se anteriormente ao sulco centr: Located anterior to the central sulcus and superior to the lateral sulcus, under the bone of the same name.
Inicia-se na base do cérebro, separando: It begins at the base of the brain, separating the frontal and temporal lobes, and directs towards the superolateral surface. It ends by dividing into three rami: ascending, anterior, and posterior.
Localiza-se abaixo do sulco lateral, sob: Located below the lateral sulcus, under the bone of the same name.
Localiza-se posteriormente aos lobos par: Located posterior to the parietal and temporal lobes and superior to the tentorium cerebelli, under the bone of the same name. It is related to visual processing.
Localiza-se posteriormente ao sulco cent: Located posterior to the central sulcus and superior to the lateral sulcus, under the bone of the same name.
Percorre obliquamente a face superolater: Runs obliquely across the superolateral surface of the cerebral hemisphere, separating the frontal (anteriorly) and parietal (posteriorly) lobes.
Tem posição paralela e posterior ao sulc: It is parallel and posterior to the central sulcus, with which it delimits the gyrus of the same name.
Giro localizado entre o sulco central e: Gyrus located between the central sulcus and the postcentral sulcus in the parietal lobe. It is where the primary somatosensory area (area for general somatic sensation) of the cerebral cortex is located.
Gyrus located between the central sulcus and the precentral sulcus in the frontal lobe. It is where the primary motor area of the cerebral cortex is located.
Tem posição paralela e anterior ao sulco: It is parallel and anterior to the central sulcus, with which it delimits the gyrus of the same name.
Ramo Ascendente do Sulco Lateral: Ascending Ramus of the Lateral Sulcus
Ramo Posterior do Sulco Lateral: Posterior Ramus of the Lateral Sulcus
Parte Orbital do Giro Frontal Inferior: Orbital Part of the Inferior Frontal Gyrus
Parte Opercular do Giro Frontal Inferior: Opercular Part of the Inferior Frontal Gyrus
Ramo Anterior do Sulco Lateral: Anterior Ramus of the Lateral Sulcus
Parte Triangular do Giro Frontal Inferio: Triangular Part of the Inferior Frontal Gyrus
Esta parte, juntamente com a parte operc: This part, along with the opercular part of the inferior frontal gyrus, forms Broca's area (in green), associated with language expression.
Separa os lóbulos parietais superior e i: Separates the superior and inferior parietal lobules.
Situa-se na junção entre os lobos pariet: Located at the junction between the parietal and temporal lobes. It is related to language perception and is connected to Broca's area by the arcuate and superior longitudinal fasciculi.
Localiza-se abaixo do sulco calcarino e: Located below the calcarine sulcus and continues anteriorly with the parahippocampal gyrus, in the temporal lobe.
Inicia-se abaixo do esplênio do corpo ca: It begins below the splenium of the corpus callosum and follows an arched path towards the occipital pole. The primary visual area of the cerebral cortex is located on its lips.
Giro de forma triangular que se localiza: A triangular-shaped gyrus located in the occipital lobe between the calcarine sulcus and the parieto-occipital sulcus.
Forma um ângulo agudo com o sulco calcar: Forms an acute angle with the calcarine sulcus and divides the occipital and parietal lobes on the medial surface.
Lóbulo que está relacionado ao término d: Lobule that is related to the termination of the central sulcus on the medial surface and, therefore, contains the primary motor (anteriorly) and somatosensory (posteriorly) areas for the lower limbs.
O corpo caloso é a maior das comissuras: The corpus callosum is the largest of the telencephalic commissures and the largest bundle in the nervous system. It connects symmetrical cortical areas of the hemispheres, with the exception of those in the temporal lobe, which are joined by the anterior commissure.
Tem curso paralelo ao corpo caloso, do q: Runs parallel to the corpus callosum, from which it is separated by the cingulate gyrus. It ends posteriorly by dividing into two rami, marginal and subparietal.
Contorna o corpo caloso, ligando-se ao g: It surrounds the corpus callosum, connecting to the parahippocampal gyrus via the isthmus of the cingulate gyrus. It is traversed by the cingulum bundle and is part of the Papez circuit.
Localizados lateralmente ao sulco olfató: Located lateral to the olfactory sulcus and above the orbit.
Importante sulco do lobo frontal, onde e: An important sulcus of the frontal lobe, where the olfactory bulb and tract are lodged.
Localizado medialmente ao sulco olfatóri: Located medial to the olfactory sulcus.
Duas delgadas lâminas de tecido nervoso: Two thin laminae of nervous tissue that separate the anterior horns and the central part of the lateral ventricles.
Fibras de projeção que liga o hipocampo: Projection fibers that connect the hippocampus to the mammillary bodies. It runs from top to bottom through each half of the hypothalamus, dividing it into medial and lateral areas.
São em número de dois e ligam cada ventr: There are two of them, and they connect each lateral ventricle to the III ventricle.
Fibras de associação inter-hemisféricas: Inter-hemispheric association fibers that connect the temporal lobes and the olfactory bulbs and tracts.
É separado do globo pálido medial pela l: It is separated from the medial globus pallidus by the internal medullary lamina and from the putamen by the external medullary lamina. Together, these three structures form the Lentiform Nucleus.
Conjunto de fibras que conecta o córtex: A set of fibers that connects the cerebral cortex to subcortical structures. Most of the fibers that leave or enter the cerebral cortex pass through it.
Fibras de projeção que dão continuidade: Projection fibers that continue the internal capsule, above the lentiform nucleus, and connect cortical and subcortical structures.
É a porção mais superior do tronco encef: It is the most superior portion of the brainstem.
Porção do tronco encefálico interposta e: Portion of the brainstem interposed between the medulla and the midbrain, located ventrally to the cerebellum. It has transverse striations at its base that converge to form the middle cerebellar peduncle.
Sulco horizontal situado entre a ponte e: Horizontal sulcus situated between the pons and the medulla. The VI, VII, and VIII cranial nerves (abducens, facial, and vestibulocochlear nerves, respectively) emerge from it, from medial to lateral. Furthermore, between the VII and VIII nerves, the so-called intermediate nerve emerges, which is the sensory root of the VII nerve.
É a porção inferior do tronco encefálico: It is the inferior portion of the brainstem.
Forame onde a fissura mediana anterior t: Foramen where the anterior median fissure ends upon meeting the bulbopontine sulcus, in the upper part of the medulla.
Nele emergem o IX, X e XI pares craniano: The IX, X, and XI cranial nerves (glossopharyngeal, vagus, and accessory nerves, respectively) emerge from it.
Nele emerge o XII par craniano (nervo hi: The XII cranial nerve (hypoglossal nerve) emerges from it.
Conjunto de fibras que ligam a medula es: Set of fibers that connect the spinal cord and the medulla to the cerebellum.
Eminência alongada formada pelas fibras: Elongated eminence formed by the fibers of the corticospinal tract. It is found on each side of the anterior median fissure, being medial to the anterolateral sulcus.
Elevação oval da superfície bulbar situa: Oval elevation on the medullary surface located between the anterolateral and posterolateral sulci of the medulla. It is formed by a large mass of gray matter, the inferior olivary nucleus, situated just below the surface.
Cruzamento das fibras do trato corticosp: Crossing of the corticospinal tract fibers in the inferior region of the medulla.
Porção anterior do mesencéfalo. Dividido: Anterior portion of the midbrain. Divided by the substantia nigra into the basis (anteriorly) and the tegmentum (posteriorly).
Conjunto de fibras que ligam a ponte ao: Set of fibers that connect the pons to the cerebellum, also known as the 'arm of the pons'. The fibers of the cortico-ponto-cerebellar pathway pass through it.
Raiz Sensitiva do Nervo Trigêmeo: Sensory Root of the Trigeminal Nerve
V par craniano, é um nervo misto predomi: V cranial nerve, it is a mixed nerve, predominantly sensory. Its two roots emerge between the pons and the middle cerebellar peduncle, with the sensory root being thicker than the motor one.
Sulco longitudinal que aloja a artéria b: Longitudinal sulcus that lodges the basilar artery.
Porção anterior da ponte, separada do te: Anterior portion of the pons, separated from the tegmentum by the trapezoid body. Longitudinal fibers (corticospinal, corticonuclear, and corticopontine tracts) and transverse fibers (ponto-cerebellar fibers and trapezoid body) pass through the base of the pons. The pontine nuclei are also located in this region.
Porção posterior da ponte, separada da b: Posterior portion of the pons, separated from the base by the trapezoid body. Various nuclei are located in the tegmentum (cochlear, vestibular, facial, abducens, superior salivatory, and lacrimal).
Canal repleto de líquor, atravessa longi: Channel filled with CSF, it runs longitudinally through the midbrain, connecting the III with the IV ventricle.
Parte anterior do pedúnculo cerebral, en: Anterior part of the cerebral peduncle, it is located ventrally to the substantia nigra.
Neurônios dopaminérgicos que encontram-s: Dopaminergic neurons found at the midbrain level that serve as a topographical landmark to separate the basis (anterior) from the tegmentum (posterior) of the cerebral peduncle. Dopamine depletion in the fibers originating there causes Parkinson's disease.
Parte posterior do pedúnculo cerebral, e: Posterior part of the cerebral peduncle, it is located dorsally to the substantia nigra.
Porção mesencefálica posterior ao aquedu: Midbrain portion posterior to the cerebral aqueduct, where the superior and inferior colliculi are located.
Elevação do teto mesencefálico, formada: Elevation of the midbrain tectum, formed by a series of alternately overlapping layers of white and gray matter. It has connections with the lateral geniculate body through the arm of the superior colliculus.
Elevação do teto mesencefálico, constitu: Elevation of the midbrain tectum, consisting of a well-defined mass of gray matter. It has connections with the medial geniculate body through the arm of the inferior colliculus.
Cavidade situada posteriormente ao bulbo: Cavity located posterior to the medulla and pons and anterior to the cerebellum. It is continuous cranially with the cerebral aqueduct and caudally with the central canal of the medulla. Its cavity is filled with CSF, produced by the choroid plexus. It has two lateral and one median foramina that communicate it with the subarachnoid space.
É formado por fibras do nervo facial, qu: It is formed by fibers of the facial nerve, which loop around the nucleus of the abducens nerve.
Área triangular onde está localizado o n: Triangular area where the nucleus of the hypoglossal nerve is located, medial to the vagal trigone.
Área triangular que corresponde ao núcle: Triangular area that corresponds to the dorsal nucleus of the vagus nerve, lateral to the hypoglossal trigone.
Ramo da artéria carótida interna, anasto: Branch of the internal carotid artery, it anastomoses with the posterior cerebral artery, connecting the anterior and posterior systems, and contributing to the formation of the Circle of Willis.
Ramo da bifurcação da artéria carótida c: Branch from the bifurcation of the common carotid artery, it ascends in the neck and enters the cranial cavity through the carotid canal. It passes through the cavernous sinus, forming the carotid siphon. It originates the anterior encephalic irrigation system (or internal carotid system), which is part of the Circle of Willis. At the beginning of the lateral sulcus, it bifurcates into the middle and anterior cerebral arteries. It also gives rise to the ophthalmic, posterior communicating, and anterior choroidal arteries.
Ramos da bifurcação da artéria basilar,: Branches from the bifurcation of the basilar artery, the posterior cerebral arteries run backward and supply the occipital lobe and the inferior surface of the temporal lobe.
Ramo da artéria basilar, origina-se imed: Branch of the basilar artery, it originates immediately before the bifurcation into the posterior cerebral arteries. It is distributed to the superior region of the cerebellum.
Ramo da artéria basilar, distribui-se à: Branch of the basilar artery, it is distributed to the anterior portion of the inferior surface of the cerebellum.
Formada pela união das artérias vertebra: Formed by the union of the right and left vertebral arteries. It runs along the anterior region of the pons and ends by bifurcating into the posterior cerebral arteries. Together with the vertebral arteries, it originates the posterior encephalic irrigation system (or vertebrobasilar system), which is part of the Circle of Willis.
Ramo da artéria basilar, penetra no meat: Branch of the basilar artery, it enters the internal acoustic meatus along with the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves, supplying structures of the inner ear.
Ramo da artéria subclávia esquerda, entr: Branch of the left subclavian artery, it enters the cranial cavity through the foramen magnum and joins the right vertebral artery to form the basilar artery.
Ramo da artéria vertebral, irriga a porç: Branch of the vertebral artery, it supplies the inferior and posterior portion of the cerebellum and the lateral area of the medulla. Lesions of this artery compromise several structures, resulting in the complex symptomatology of Wallenberg Syndrome.
Composto pelo bulbo, ponte e mesencéfalo: Composed of the medulla, pons, and midbrain. It is interposed between the spinal cord and the diencephalon, situated ventrally to the cerebellum.
Porção mediana do cérebro. É formado pel: Median portion of the brain. It is formed by the thalamus, hypothalamus, subthalamus, and epithalamus.
Telencéfalo é a porção do cérebro consti: Telencephalon is the portion of the brain consisting of two cerebral hemispheres (left and right) and the lamina terminalis.
Sulco profundo que separa incompletament: Deep groove that incompletely separates the two cerebral hemispheres.
